info.name: H8 Course: REST API Python
info.description:
**Author:** [Yoga Perdana Putra](https://s.id/yogapp)
This test collection is used for the project [Learning REST API with Python](https://github.com/yogaperdana/H8-REST-API/). Any other documentation of the application, please refer to the [readme file](https://github.com/yogaperdana/H8-REST-API/blob/py/README.md) on project repository. If you want to start the collection test runner, please select tests within folder based on project's version. For example, for the first commit version of project (v1.0), then select only tests on folder `v1.0 - Static Data`.
